nameOrigin.text: The town was named for Granby Hillyer, a lawyer and state legislator who laid out its streets for the Frontier Land and Investment Company.

founded.text: Founded in 1905 as a logging and railroad community

timeline.text: David Moffat's company platted the town; the Moffat Railroad reached it in September 1905.
Rodeo began in Granby; the Flying Heels Arena has been at its current site since 1969.
The Rocky Mountain Airways terminal was built at the Granby airport, and the airline's first flight landed on July 20.
The aviation museum opened in July and the airport was named Emily Warner Field.
